---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Gabbybee4"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-storms

storms |>
  # Filter to the three main tropical cyclone classifications
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  # Order factor levels from weakest to strongest
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |>
  # Keep one row per storm per year and status, then count and fill any zero-count years
  distinct(year, name, status) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  complete(year, status, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Atlantic Storms by Type and Year",
    subtitle = "Annual count of tropical depressions, tropical storms, and hurricanes",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type",
    caption = "Source: NOAA Atlantic hurricane database (dplyr::storms)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: print-storms
#| cache: true
storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-pressure-wind

storms_recent |>
  # Map storm status to point color
  ggplot(aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  # Make points semi-transparent so dense, overlapping regions are visible
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Air Pressure Drops as Wind Speed Increases in Atlantic Storms",
    subtitle = "Six-hourly storm observations since 2000 by storm classification",
    x = "Maximum Sustained Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Atmospheric Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Storm Status",
    caption = "Source: NOAA Atlantic hurricane database (dplyr::storms)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
